nodes.label: Beacon five-process QNX isolation
nodes.rationale: supervisor, camd and guided on core 0; percept and voiced off core 0; separate address spaces so a percept crash cannot take guided with it.

nodes.label: QNX 8.0 has no APS
nodes.rationale: Adaptive partitioning is not on the loaner image; mixed criticality is processes, priorities, runmasks, seqlocked shm and a supervisor, and the pitch must never claim APS.

nodes.label: Runmask core-0 isolation (single-CPU masks only)
nodes.rationale: The image rejects multi-bit runmasks (0xe returns EINVAL), so everything that must stay off core 0 pins 0x2 on one core and logs the kernel readback.

nodes.label: Seqlocked per-writer shared memory
nodes.rationale: Each writer has its own seq so guided never blocks on a mutex percept might hold when it dies; guided skips torn reads.

nodes.label: Honest limits (no second output channel, multi-bit runmasks rejected, camd liveness only)
nodes.norm_label: honest limits (no second output channel, multi-bit runmasks rejected, camd liveness only)
nodes.rationale: No buzzer exists, so a guided fault is a log line and a fast respawn, never a fault tone; the pitch must not claim one.
